entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I undid my tie slowly and rose from..."
entries.dialogueText: I undid my tie slowly and rose from my seat in the protected bunker on the outskirts of Holsord. I increased the volume of the crackling radio.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Despite our location many meters un..."
entries.dialogueText: Despite our location many meters underground, I felt the room shaking. It must've been the bombs.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He stumbled inside, collapsed on th..."
entries.dialogueText: He stumbled inside, collapsed on the couch and took a huge slug of my whiskey.

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“They are here, Mr. President.”"
entries.dialogueText: “They are here, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“They are inside the Palace. They a..."
entries.dialogueText: “They are inside the Palace. They are coming for you.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I heard gunfire and more screams fr..."
entries.dialogueText: I heard gunfire and more screams from the floor beneath us.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Tell me Iosef. What did I do wrong..."
entries.dialogueText: “Tell me Iosef. What did I do wrong? What did I do to deserve this?”
entries.menuText: “Tell me Iosef. What did I do wrong? What did I do to deserve this?”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“I don't know, Mr. President. Maybe..."
entries.dialogueText: “I don't know, Mr. President. Maybe you were just at the wrong place at the wrong time.”

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I pointed the gun towards the soldi..."
entries.dialogueText: I pointed the gun towards the soldier.
entries.menuText: Point the gun towards the soldier.

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Don't forget about that handgun I..."
entries.dialogueText: “Don't forget about that handgun I gave you. Of course, it's up to you how you want to use it."

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Well, that's my cue.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Well, that's my cue.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He pointed to his belt. I saw sever..."
entries.dialogueText: He pointed to his belt. I saw several grenades hanging from it.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Iosef turned to me."
entries.dialogueText: Iosef turned to me.

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“No matter what, it was an honor to..."
entries.dialogueText: “No matter what, it was an honor to serve you, sir.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Likewise, Iosef.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Likewise, Iosef.”
entries.menuText: “Likewise, Iosef.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I'll see you on the other side.""
entries.dialogueText: “I'll see you on the other side."
entries.menuText: “I'll see you on the other side."

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I saluted him and he saluted me bac..."
entries.dialogueText: I saluted him and he saluted me back.
entries.menuText: Salute him.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He saluted me."
entries.dialogueText: He saluted me.

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“A Morgna wes core!”"
entries.dialogueText: “A Morgna wes core!”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Vectern sis da!”"
entries.dialogueText: “Vectern sis da!”
entries.menuText: “Vectern sis da!”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Iosef ran to the door and opened it..."
entries.dialogueText: Iosef ran to the door and opened it. I heard the metallic sounds of the pins being removed from the grenades.

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "<shout>“Greci Sordland!”</shout>"
entries.dialogueText: <shout>“Greci Sordland!”</shout>

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Gunshots rang out, then an ear-spli..."
entries.dialogueText: Gunshots rang out, then an ear-splitting explosion, followed by silence.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A good long minute passed. Then, I..."
entries.dialogueText: A good long minute passed. Then, I heard the faint sound of approaching footsteps.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I redid my tie and looked at myself..."
entries.dialogueText: I redid my tie and looked at myself in the mirror before sitting down at my desk.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I looked down at the gun Iosef had..."
entries.dialogueText: I looked down at the gun Iosef had given me and shifted it from one hand to the other.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I pointed the gun towards my own he..."
entries.dialogueText: I pointed the gun towards my own head.
entries.menuText: Point the gun towards your own head.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The door burst open and a soldier i..."
entries.dialogueText: The door burst open and a soldier in Rumburgian uniform stormed in. He turned his rifle on me.

entries.title: Narrator: "“The enemy is advancing on us. Requ..."
entries.dialogueText: “The enemy is advancing on us. Requesting backup. We are surrounded from all sides. I repeat, we are surro--”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "“They are using some kind of a gas...."
entries.dialogueText: “They are using some kind of a gas. Our soldiers' eyes and ears are bleeding. We need immediate assistance on Victory Avenue. Medics! We need more medics!”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "“They are coming in through the out..."
entries.dialogueText: “They are coming in through the outer gates. They killed everyone. We surrendered our weapons but they won't stop shooting. If there is a God, I beg you. Please end this.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "“They are approaching the Maroon Pa..."
entries.dialogueText: “They are approaching the Maroon Palace. We must protect the president at all costs. Squad 6 will initiate the final charge while we barricade the palace. Please tell my wife I love her. Greci Sordland!”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Right now, he was monitoring commun..."
entries.dialogueText: Right now, he was monitoring communications in the adjoining room. I walked in and he saluted.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "“If there is anyone listening right..."
entries.dialogueText: “If there is anyone listening right now... please. The world needs to know what is going on. This is no longer a war. This is a massacre! Squad 2 out.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I looked at Monica and Deana. Deana..."
entries.dialogueText: I looked at Monica and Deana. Deana's face was streaked with tears.

entries.speaker: Deana
entries.title: Deana: "“Papa, are we going to die like Fra..."
entries.dialogueText: “Papa, are we going to die like Franc did?”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica started sobbing uncontrollab..."
entries.dialogueText: Monica started sobbing uncontrollably. But there were no tears. She ran out many days ago, when we received the news of Franc's death near the border.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I breathed a sigh of relief that Mo..."
entries.dialogueText: I breathed a sigh of relief that Monica and Deana were safely on their way to Arcasia, where they would meet up with Franc. My family wouldn't be paying for my mistakes.

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.title: Narrator: "I looked at Monica, Deana and Franc..."
entries.dialogueText: I looked at Monica, Deana and Franc. Deana started running to me, crying. I wiped her tears away.

entries.speaker: Deana
entries.title: Deana: "“Papa. Are we going to die?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Papa. Are we going to die?”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I breathed a sigh of relief that Mo..."
entries.dialogueText: I breathed a sigh of relief that Monica, Deana and Franc were on their way to Benfi, where they'd be safe from the bloodshed. I had sent them there under the protection of Franc's army squad.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They were supposed to have gotten t..."
entries.dialogueText: They were supposed to have gotten there right about now.

entries.dialogueText: Iosef walked back over to me.

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Mr. President. I am afraid I have..."
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. President. I am afraid I have bad news.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“The military convoy carrying your..."
entries.dialogueText: “The military convoy carrying your children and ex-wife was ambushed by Rumburg troops on its way out of Holsord. Franc sacrificed his life in order to grant safe passage to Monica, your daughter, and the rest of his squad."

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“He died a hero, sir.”"
entries.dialogueText: “He died a hero, sir.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“This can't be true.”"
entries.dialogueText: “This can't be true.”
entries.menuText: “This can't be true.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I need a minute, Iosef.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I need a minute, Iosef.”
entries.menuText: “I need a minute, Iosef.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“I'm afraid it is, sir. He valiantl..."
entries.dialogueText: “I'm afraid it is, sir. He valiantly gave his life for Sordland.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Of course, sir.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Of course, sir.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“I will give you some time.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I will give you some time.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He left me alone in the room. I wep..."
entries.dialogueText: He left me alone in the room. I wept uncontrollably until I exhausted myself and passed out.

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Monica and Deana are unharmed and..."
entries.dialogueText: “Monica and Deana are unharmed and will be arriving in Benfi soon."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“This is all my fault. I caused my..."
entries.dialogueText: “This is all my fault. I caused my son's death.”
entries.menuText: “This is all my fault. I caused my son's death.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Please do not blame yourself, Mr...."
entries.dialogueText: “Please do not blame yourself, Mr. President. We need you to be strong. Your country needs you to be strong.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Death is never the end, my dear da..."
entries.dialogueText: “Death is never the end, my dear daughter. It comes to all of us at one point in our lives.”
entries.menuText: “Death is never the end, my dear daughter. It comes to all of us at one point in our lives.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“No. We will not die, Deana. As lon..."
entries.dialogueText: “No. We will not die, Deana. As long as I am here, don't worry.”
entries.menuText: “No. We will not die, Deana. As long as I am here, don't worry.”

entries.dialogueText: I kept silent and hugged her.
entries.menuText: Keep silent and hug her.

entries.dialogueText: “That's not the answer I was looking for."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“I don't know, Anton. Franc is gone..."
entries.dialogueText: “I don't know, Anton. Franc is gone and Sordland's a wreck... how are we supposed to go on?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Deana is still here, Monica.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Deana is still here, Monica.”
entries.menuText: “Deana is still here, Monica.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We still have each other. We need..."
entries.dialogueText: “We still have each other. We need to live for his sake.”
entries.menuText: “We still have each other. We need to live for his sake.”

entries.speaker: Player

entries.dialogueText: “We have no choice.”

entries.menuText: “No. We will not die, Deana. As long as I am here, don't worry.”

entries.dialogueText: I kept silent and hugged her.

entries.dialogueText: "All right. I trust you, Papa."

entries.dialogueText: We went to a corner where Deana wouldn't be able to hear us.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“Anton, can you come here for a sec..."
entries.dialogueText: “Anton, can you come here for a second?”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“What is really going on? Tell me t..."
entries.dialogueText: “What is really going on? Tell me the truth.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We will make through this somehow...."
entries.dialogueText: “We will make through this somehow. I promise.”
entries.menuText: “We will make through this somehow. I promise.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We are most likely done for.”"
entries.dialogueText: “We are most likely done for.”
entries.menuText: “We are most likely done for.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“The enemy is preparing to breach t..."
entries.dialogueText: “The enemy is preparing to breach the Palace. It's only a matter of time before they realize you're not there."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“How long until they find us?""
entries.dialogueText: “How long until they find us?"
entries.menuText: “How long until they find us?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Are we safe here, Iosef?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Are we safe here, Iosef?”
entries.menuText: “Are we safe here, Iosef?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“What do you make of the situation?..."
entries.dialogueText: “What do you make of the situation?”
entries.menuText: “What do you make of the situation?”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Don't worry, sir. Unless they some..."
entries.dialogueText: “Don't worry, sir. Unless they somehow got their hands on the Palace schematics, they don't know about the secret tunnel that leads here from the Situation Room."

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“And besides, this room was built t..."
entries.dialogueText: “And besides, this room was built to withstand nuclear attacks. We should be safe here for the moment. The diversion at the Palace should buy us some time."

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Of course, the question is how muc..."
entries.dialogueText: “Of course, the question is how much time. We have lost contact with the squadrons protecting the outer perimeter of the palace.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Your guess is as good as my own at..."
entries.dialogueText: “Your guess is as good as my own at this point.”

entries.dialogueText: After thanking Iosef, I went back to the main room.

entries.dialogueText: “You better keep that promise, Anton.”

entries.speaker: Monica

entries.dialogueText: “But, Deana... Franc...”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She went back near Deana."
entries.dialogueText: She went back near Deana.

entries.title: Narrator: "Franc walked up to me."
entries.dialogueText: Franc walked up to me.

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: "“Dad. Seriously, tell me. Are we sc..."
entries.dialogueText: “Dad. Seriously, tell me. Are we screwed?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I wish I knew that, son.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I wish I knew that, son.”
entries.menuText: “I wish I knew that, son.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Don't fret. You are a Rayne. You h..."
entries.dialogueText: “Don't fret. You are a Rayne. You have to be strong.”
entries.menuText: “Don't fret. You are a Rayne. You have to be strong.”

entries.dialogueText: “So, the answer is yes, then."

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: "“Not very reassuring.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Not very reassuring.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Iosef came out of the communication..."
entries.dialogueText: Iosef came out of the communications room and pulled me aside.

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Sir. The Palace is about to fall...."
entries.dialogueText: “Sir. The Palace is about to fall. And one of the Rumburg combatants was overheard saying he'd located the tunnel entrance."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“So is this the end?”"
entries.dialogueText: “So is this the end?”
entries.menuText: “So is this the end?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“What are we going to do?”"
entries.dialogueText: “What are we going to do?”
entries.menuText: “What are we going to do?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I order you to get us out of here...."
entries.dialogueText: “I order you to get us out of here. Immediately.”
entries.menuText: “I order you to get us out of here. Immediately.”

entries.dialogueText: “I'm afraid that is not possible. They've got troops stationed in the woods above us. The only way to get out is through the Palace or not at all."

entries.dialogueText: “Our hands are tied. They've got troops stationed in the woods above us. The only way to get out is through the Palace or not at all."

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Looks like it. They've got troops..."
entries.dialogueText: “Looks like it. They've got troops stationed in the woods above us. The only way to get out is through the Palace or not at all."

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“If I were you I would start saying..."
entries.dialogueText: “If I were you I would start saying my prayers, sir.”

entries.speaker: Player

entries.dialogueText: “I want to see my office one last time.”
entries.menuText: “I want to see my office one last time.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Look around. Get comfortable.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Look around. Get comfortable.”

entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Because this room will be our grav..."
entries.dialogueText: “Because this room will be our grave.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We will barricade ourselves in and..."
entries.dialogueText: “We will barricade ourselves in and hope for the best.”
entries.menuText: “We will barricade ourselves in and hope for the best.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Are you mad? Do you want to run st..."
entries.dialogueText: “Are you mad? Do you want to run straight into the enemy's sights?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“At least I will die fighting inste..."
entries.dialogueText: “At least I will die fighting instead of cowering down here.”
entries.menuText: “At least I will die fighting instead of cowering down here.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Why does it matter if we're going..."
entries.dialogueText: “Why does it matter if we're going to die anyway?"
entries.menuText: “Why does it matter if we're going to die anyway?"

entries.dialogueText: His eyes started shining.

entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Yes! I always wanted to go out wit..."
entries.dialogueText: “Yes! I always wanted to go out with a bang anyway!”

entries.dialogueText: He took off his jacket and walked over to the bunker's weapons cache, loading himself up with everything that was left.

entries.dialogueText: He turned to me and gave me his handgun.
